synopsis: The Alliance for Automotive Innovation challenged the feasibility of FMVSS 127, calling it practically impossible with available technology in June 2024 [f10864]. Alongside Toyota and Volkswagen, it petitioned for reconsideration, raising false-positive risk among other concerns [f1517]. Petitioners including the Alliance and Volkswagen also argued for judging compliance over multiple trials; NHTSA rejected that position in its 26 November 2024 rule, Docket NHTSA-2023-0021, stating that FMVSS 127 testing is distinct from FMVSS No. 135 testing [f2889]. The Alliance filed for judicial review on 17 January 2025, but the supplied facts give no outcome of that review [f1519].

relations.note: Adds the multiple-trial compliance argument and NHTSA’s rejection to the reconsideration dispute.
The feasibility objection provides context for the Alliance’s petition challenging the rule.
Adds a subsequent judicial challenge to the Alliance’s reconsideration effort.
